bayts.text: Praise be to the Manifest Truth (Al-Ḥaqq al-Mubīn, Allah), He whose Being is evident to me, for the clear Book (the Qur'an) and for all His blessings.
I praise my Lord, the Immense, with abundant praise that never ceases, invoking blessing upon a Generous one (Muḥammad) who led the creatures to the Giver of blessings (Allah).
I give thanks to the Lord of the Glorious Throne, with a thanksgiving met by increase, greeting with peace the Incomparable one (Muḥammad) with all my breast and my speech.
I gave Him thanks for singling me out for the service of the Effacer (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), the sublime; a service rendered openly, and He loosed my fetters.
To Him my words are addressed, calling to what He loves, persevering; and He has led my aims to me, as provision for the Abode of Generosity (Paradise).
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord! O our Lord, accept our striving through the Chosen One (Muḥammad), the Revered.
For the Chosen One (Muḥammad), for whom blessing and peace are sought, together with the eulogy of every year, I have asked of Him who honours (Allah).
Bless him who was made the Pole of existence (Quṭb al-wujūd) when he descended into it, and his Family, rich in gifts, and his Companions, and honour them.
Bless him who was made the best of Prophets, the favoured one, when our father (Adam) still lay in his clay; and magnify him.
And grant peace, O my Lord, to the Seal of the Prophets and of the chosen Messengers, our venerated Imām (Muḥammad).
And bless, O Lord of Grace, the Messenger of Mercy, the bolt of the gate of retribution, the cause (of the creation) of every soul.
And grant peace, O my Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), to the Prophet Muḥammad, his Family and those who praise, and be with whoever follows in his footsteps.
O Lord of Permanence and Eternity, accept my services from me, and through them please him who holds precedence (Muḥammad), O You who illumine the path.
He is the choicest of the Arabs, he grants what is needed, he is the way of seeking, the physician of the sick.
Bless the Gate of Guidance, far-reaching, dispenser of munificence, lion against the foes, effacer of perdition, gateway of the heights and of generosity.
And grant peace to the Trustworthy (Al-Amīn, Muḥammad): he is the Firm and the Strong, he is the Protector and the Worthy of this praise; and honour him.
He is the Incomparable and the Glorious, he is the Dutiful and the Singular, who with uprightness leads to the Gardens whoever was blind (in spirit).
Pour forth blessing and peace, O All-Powerful, upon Your Illuminating Lamp (as-Sirāj al-Munīr, Muḥammad): he is the Bearer of glad tidings and the Warner, with punishments and with blessings.
He is the Messenger of Mercy, he is vast in mercy, he is the master of eloquence, he is the Messenger of the great battle (al-malḥama).
Pour forth blessing and peace forever, O You who sufficed me against grief, upon the Radiant Aḥmad (Muḥammad), and be with me in Your favours.
Adorn my outward and my inward with beauty through the Pure One (Muḥammad), O You who, by his rank, erase my grave sins and my lesser faults.
O You with whom is my hope, on my behalf pour forth Your blessing upon the Enwrapped One (Al-Muzzammil, Muḥammad), together with all the perfected and all the communities.
And grant peace, O Originator (Al-Badīʿ), to the Obeyed and the Obedient: he is the Intercessor whose intercession is accepted, Your magnified Beloved.
Bless the Venerated one (Muḥammad), O You who have shielded from shame; with You erase my fear, and with him magnify him.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Intimate Friend, O our Beloved, accept our writings from us through Your Chosen One (Muḥammad), the ladder (to You).
Pour forth blessing and peace upon him (Muḥammad) who answered "Yes!" (Balā), first of all, on the Day of "Am I not (your Lord)?" (Alastu), before all who spoke.
Bless the best of Messengers, O You who through him bestow what is asked, together with the Family and the upright Companions, and accept my pen.
Grant that my pen be glad tidings of the one placed foremost (Muḥammad), and through him decree my pre-eminence, without harm or pain.
Bless the best of Prophets, who led the creatures with refined conduct (al-adab), O You who by his rank have sufficed me against my misconduct; and grant peace.
He is the one who, by his guidance, surpassed all other creatures, until his name appeared written upon Your magnified Throne,
in the Gardens and upon the (heavenly) vaults, upon faces and in caves; and with spears and swords he uprooted every idol.
He led the rightly guided to bliss with the best of his Remembrances, the wise (the Qur'an), through his Lord, the Everlasting, the Ancient: glory be to Him who never sleeps!
Pour forth blessing and peace forever upon him for whom, on the night he was born, those persisting in sin were driven away.
The night of the Prophet's birth (Mawlid) is the night when doubts are erased, the night when toil is erased and the sinner is purified.
In it are salvation and success, with joy and attainment; in it gain and righteousness, with the repelling of punishments.
It held manifest wonders, attested by the transmitters, like the (sacred Persian) fire that was put out, together with the dissolving of abasement;
and the lake of Sāwa, which had been magnified and revered by the Persians before the (true) religion, and was reduced to nothing;
and like the falling of the shooting stars, to drive the people of doubt (the devils) from eavesdropping on the Prophet's tidings; and they returned full of remorse.
In it the Stoned One (Satan) was driven from the heavens by the stars, and fled defeated, blameworthy, with his faction, full of grief and anguish.
It (the light) shone forth when the best of Prophets was born, who appeared (in the world); may He (Allah) who guided his heart with wisdoms send blessing upon him.
An immense light, by which whoever was in the Mother of Cities, Mecca, the best of sanctuaries, saw the palaces of Caesar.
In it the palace of Chosroes split, which before had been raised high, its vault soaring towards the heaven of Him who honours (Allah);
until even the throne was shattered, by the terror that enveloped it, before the light of the best of creation: O Lord, grant him peace,
after a blessing that never ceases, with the Family and the upright Companions; and through me renew the Path, without enemies or pain.
Pour forth blessing and peace upon him whose birth drove away towards others than us those who harbour hatred, and accept my services.
His birth (the Mawlid) is magnified, blessed, revered; honouring it is a duty for those who hold precedence (in faith).
Honouring it according to the Sunna leads us to Paradise; through it grace increases for whoever is sincere and honours it.
Whoever honours the birth of our Prophet, Gate of Guidance, will not be called to account tomorrow: so respect it and honour it.
Whoever honours the birth of the best of creatures, Aḥmad (Muḥammad), is like one who was present at Badr, without any illusion.
Whoever has spent wealth for his noble birth, without extravagance, even to the value of a single dirham,
